void ActivateDocument ( IApplication  sender,
IDocument  document,
Boolean  activated 
)

Sent when the active document changes. For example, switching the active document from DocumentA to DocumentB calls this event twice: once for DocumentA (activated = False) and once for DocumentB (activated = True), in that order.

Parameters:
senderas IApplication, specifies the application.
documentas IDocument, specifies the document.
activatedas Boolean, specifies whether the document was made active (True) or inactive (False).
Returns:
None

Boolean Command ( IApplication  sender,
String  menuLabel,
String  userData 
)

Sent when a custom menu item is selected.

Parameters:
senderas IApplication, specifies the application.
menuLabelas String, specifies the menu name (as defined by AddMenuItem()).
userDataas String, specifies the user data (as defined by AddMenuItem()), which lets you uniquely identify the command without using menuLabel (which might change).
Returns:
True: Success
False: Failure
See also:
AddMenuItem()

Boolean UpdateCommandUI ( IApplication  sender,
String  menuLabel,
Long  state,
String  userData 
)

Sent when Composer needs the state of a menu item.

Parameters:
senderas IApplication, specifies the application.
menuLabelas String, specifies the menu name (as defined by AddMenuItem()).
stateas Long (CrUpdateCommandState enum), specifies the command state:

  • crEnabled (1)
  • crChecked (2)
  • crRadio (4)
userDataas String, specifies the user data (as defined by AddMenuItem()), which lets you uniquely identify the command without using menuLabel (which might change).
Returns:
True: Success
False: Failure
See also:
AddMenuItem()
